**In one line**: SoftBank reportedly beat quarterly earnings estimates, with a U.S. chip investment — not any OpenAI-related gain — doing the heavy lifting.

### Key points
- SoftBank's latest quarterly results came in above analyst expectations, according to reports.
- MarketWatch reported that the results were carried by a U.S. chip company investment rather than OpenAI-linked holdings.
- Surging AI-chip demand is seen feeding valuation gains across SoftBank's investment portfolio.

### Why it matters
SoftBank's results are often read as a gauge of the AI infrastructure investment cycle. The fact that earnings held up on chip exposure alone — without an OpenAI boost — suggests the current AI rally leans more on hardware (silicon) demand than on any single model company.
